blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.
blocks.zh: 多教师政策分解(MOPD)使一名学生能够通过学习自己产生的答复来吸收几个域教师的技能。 我们介绍多模式模式多教学者政策分解因子(M3OPD-Reasoner),这是训练后视觉语言模式(VLM)在三个推理领域完全开放的配方:图像STEM,图像感知和视频. 我们管理两个数据集,M3OPD-SFT-1.35M用于有监督的微调(SFT)和M3OPD-RL-193K用于强化学习,并有可核查的奖励. 根据这些数据,我们比较了从Quen3.5-9B开始的训练后食谱:对所有领域(MixSFT和MixRL)的混合数据培训一个模型,直接或经过SFT热身后,每个领域培训一名教师,并将教师分解为MOPD的一个学生。 我们用21个图像 STEM,图像感知, 和视频推理基准 来评估, 比较将直接从Quen3.5-9B接受普惠制教学培训的教师的MOPD确定为最佳配方:学生在自己的领域与每位教师密切匹配,平均高于同一提示的混合培训基线。 由于MOPD已经合并了MixRL否则必须学习的域名能力,所以其学生是RL的更强起点,我们询问同样的数据能否从那里更进一步地携带模型:我们把MixRL加到MOPD学生的上方,在相同的提示上和设置上,据我们所知,没有研究过之前的VLM配方. 同样的提示仍然改善了MOPD的学生,没有倒塌,并给出了我们的主要模型M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. 因此,MOPD和MixRL可以作为连续的阶段工作,从同一个数据中获取更多的数据. 我们公布所有数据 训练守则 以及每个阶段的检查站

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Open recipes for reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced quickly: OpenMMReasoner [ 102 ] , Video-R1 [ 13 ] , Video-Thinker [ 69 ] , OneThinker [ 14 ] and Vero [ 58 ] all report strong results on image or video benchmarks.
Most of them follow two phases, which have been common since DeepSeek-R1 [ 22 ] .
A supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase, often on a mix of domains (MixSFT), gives the model a cold start and teaches it a reasoning style, and reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards on mixed-domain prompts (MixRL) then strengthens its reasoning.
Vero shows that MixRL alone, on a large mixed set of 600K samples, also works without SFT, and recent VLM releases similarly train on the union of the domain data [ 19 , 5 ] .
Another route trains one RL expert per domain and then merges their weights [ 24 , 85 ] , and recent text studies often compare this route with MixRL [ 67 , 79 ] .
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)中推理的开放食谱已经迅速进步: OpenMReasoner [102], Video-R1 [13], Video-Thinker [69], OneThinker [14]和Vero [58] 都报道了在图像或视频基准上的有力结果.
大部分都分出两个阶段,自DeepSeek-R1 [22]起就很常见.
一个有监督的微调(SFT)阶段,经常在混合域(MixSFT)上,给模型一个冷的起步并教它一种推理风格,在混合域提示(MixRL)上具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RL)后会强化其推理.
Vero显示,仅MixRL就在一个600K样本的大型混合组上,同样在没有SFT的情况下工作,而最近的VLM在域数据的结合上释放出类似的列车[19,5].
另一条路由每个域都培训出一名RL专家,然后将他们的权重相合并[24,85],而最近的文字研究经常将这条路由与MixRL[67,79]相提并论.

blocks.en:
More recently, On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has become a better alternative to off-policy distillation [ 2 , 20 ] .
In OPD, the student samples its own responses and the teacher scores every token of the response, which reduces the exposure bias of training on teacher-generated text.
Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) extends OPD to one RL teacher per domain, where each prompt goes to the teacher of its domain, and has become a common post-training method to unify the capabilities of one model [ 82 , 45 , 92 ] .
Building on this, several studies report that MOPD outperforms MixRL on text [ 45 ] and on images [ 37 , 84 ] , and also weight merging [ 45 , 84 ] .
They give two reasons: in MixRL, a gain in one domain can come with a loss in another [ 45 ] , and the gradients of different capabilities conflict [ 84 ] , whereas MOPD keeps the skill of each domain in a dedicated teacher.
blocks.zh:
最近, " 政策上消化 " (OPD)已成为 " 非政策上分馏 " [2、20]的更好替代方案。
在OPD中,学生对自己的回应进行抽样,老师对响应的每个符号都进行分数,这降低了师资生成文本培训的曝光偏差.
多教师政策分解(MOPD)将OPD扩展为每个域一名RL老师,每个导出都去其域名的老师,并成为统一一个型号[82,45,92]能力的通用后培训方法.
在此基础上,一些研究报告指出,MOPD在文本[45]和图像[37,84]上都优于MixRL,而且重量合并[45,84]。
他们给出了两个理由:在MixRL中,一个域的得分可以随着另一个域的失分而来 [45],不同能力的梯度相冲突 [84],而MOPD则将每个域的技巧保存在一个专门的老师中.

blocks.en:
However, this recipe is not yet well established for reasoning VLMs.
MMVistaReason [ 37 ] also goes from SFT through GSPO experts to MOPD, but it covers images only.
SCOPED [ 84 ] also distills image-skill experts only, and Video-MOPD [ 53 ] adds video teachers but compares only against model merging.
These recipes end at distillation, and other multimodal students add the reward inside the distillation stage [ 106 , 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
然而,这种方法还没有很好地用于推理。
MMVista Reason [37] 也通过普惠制O专家从SFT到MOPD,但只涵盖图像.
SCOPED [84] 也只提炼出图像技能专家,而Video-MOPD [53] 增加视频教师,但只比较模型合并.
这些食谱以蒸馏结束,而其他多式学生则在蒸馏阶段内添加奖励[106,35].

blocks.en:
Moreover, a comparison of MOPD and MixRL as competing routes misses how the two relate.
In the two-phase recipe, MixRL starts from the base or SFT model and has two tasks at once: it must merge the capabilities of all domains into one policy, and it must push the reasoning of that policy further.
Since MOPD has proven more effective at the first of these tasks [ 45 , 37 ] , its student offers a stronger starting point for RL than the base or SFT model.
This raises a question that the comparison leaves open: from this new starting point, can RL on the same data still carry the model further?
To our knowledge, such a separate reward-driven stage after MOPD remains unstudied for VLMs.
blocks.zh:
此外,将MOPD和MixRL作为相互竞争的路线进行比较,忽略了两者之间的关系。
在分两个阶段的配方中,MixRL从基础或SFT模式开始,并同时有两个任务:它必须把所有领域的能力合并为一个政策,它必须更深入地推动这一政策的推理.
由于MOPD在最初这些任务[45,37]中被证明是更有效的,因此其学生为RL提供了比基数或SFT模型更强大的起点.
这就提出了一个问题,即比较没有打开:从这个新的起点开始,同一数据上的RL还能进一步携带模型吗?
据我们所知,在MOPD仍未对VLM进行研究之后,这样一个单独的奖励驱动阶段。

blocks.en:
In this work, we present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M 3 OPD-Reasoner) , a fully open recipe for reasoning VLMs across image STEM reasoning (math, science, and logic problems), image perception reasoning (charts, documents, counting, and spatial questions), and video reasoning (Figure 2 ).
We first build the data of each domain (Section 3.1 ), and on these data, starting from Qwen3.5-9B [ 54 ] , we compare post-training recipes.
The mixed-training recipes train one model on the union of the domain data with MixSFT, MixRL, or both.
The multi-teacher recipe trains one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) [ 107 ] on the RL prompts of that domain, directly or after an SFT warm-up, and then distills the three teachers into one student with MOPD.
The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe (Section 4.2 ).
Finally, we initialize MixRL from the MOPD student and train it on the same prompts with the same GSPO settings. This additional stage further improves the student and yields our main model, M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B.
Beyond the final model, we release every part of the recipe, from the data and the training code to the checkpoints of all stages.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们介绍了多模式模式多教学者政策分解因子(M 3 OPD-Reasoner),这是跨图像STEM推理(图像、科学和逻辑问题)、图像感知推理(图表、文档、计数和空间问题)和视频推理(图2)的完全开放的推理方法。
我们首先建立每个域的数据(第3.1节),从Quen3.5-9B[54]开始,我们比较培训后的食谱。
混合训练配方在域数据与MixSFT,MixRL结合上训练出一种模式,或两者兼有.
由多教师配方在RL提示上直接或经过SFT热身后,每个域用Group序列政策优化(GSPO)[107]训练出一名教师,然后将这三名教师与MOPD蒸馏成一名学生.
比较后,将直接从Quen3.5-9B得到普惠制教学培训的教师的MOPD确定为最佳食谱(第4.2节)。
最后,我们从MOPD的学生中初始化了MixRL,并用相同的普惠制O设置在相同的提示上对其进行培训. 这个附加阶段进一步提高了学生的素质,并产生了我们的主要模型M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B.
除了最后的模型之外,我们发布了食谱的每一部分,从数据和培训代码到各个阶段的检查站.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We build a fully open recipe for the three reasoning domains and release all of it: the data, with M 3 OPD-SFT-1.35M (1.35M samples for SFT) and M 3 OPD-RL-193K (193K prompts with verifiable answers for RL), the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage. • We compare post-training recipes for multimodal reasoning on the same data, from mixed training with MixSFT and MixRL to MOPD of GSPO domain teachers with or without an SFT warm-up, and we establish MOPD of teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: its student matches each teacher on its own domain and is above the mixed-training baselines overall. • We study MixRL on top of the MOPD student as a final stage, which starts RL from the stronger point that MOPD provides instead of from the base model. To our knowledge, this is the first study of a separate RL stage after multi-teacher distillation in VLMs. On the same prompts and settings, the stage still improves the MOPD student with no collapse, and we analyze how the stronger start changes the course of MixRL.
blocks.zh: - 我们的捐助如下: 我们为三个推理领域建立了一个完全开放的食谱,并发布所有数据:M 3 OPD-SFT-1.35M(1.35M样本用于SFT)和M 3 OPD-RL-193K(193K提示,对RL有可核查的答案)、培训守则和每个阶段的检查站。 我们在同一数据上比较了培训后多式联运推理方法,从与MixSFT和MixRL的混合培训到有或无SFT热身的普惠制O域教师的MOPD,我们建立了直接从Qune3.5-9B培训的教师的MOPD,作为最佳方法:其学生在自己的域内与每个教师匹配,并且总体高于混合培训基线。 我们在MOPD学生上方学习MixRL作为决赛阶段,从MOPD提供的更强点开始RL,而不是从基模开始. 据我们所知,这是在VLMs进行多教师分馏后,首次研究单独的RL阶段. 在相同的提示和设置上,舞台仍然改善MOPD的学生而不会倒塌,我们分析更强大的起步如何改变MixRL的行进.

To our knowledge, this is the first study of a separate RL stage after multi-teacher distillation in VLMs. On the same prompts and settings, the stage still improves the MOPD student with no collapse, and we analyze how the stronger start changes the course of MixRL.

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation [ 2 , 20 ] is now a standard post-training stage for small models [ 86 ] .
For VLMs, single-teacher variants reweight visually grounded tokens [ 38 ] , steer the update toward visual grounding [ 95 ] , or transfer reasoning from a text teacher [ 7 ] .
MOPD extends this setting to several domain teachers [ 82 , 45 , 92 ] .
Later studies address the imbalance between domains [ 18 , 63 ] , arbitrate between teachers per token [ 93 ] , or protect general skills [ 94 ] , and one compares it with off-policy SFT on teacher outputs [ 83 ] .
Multi-teacher recipes for VLMs distill image-skill experts [ 84 ] , video and image experts [ 53 ] , and RL teachers for text, image, video and agent tasks [ 28 ] .
The closest work is MMVistaReason [ 37 ] , which trains image-reasoning GSPO experts on Qwen3.5 and distills them into one student by MOPD, with open data.
In comparison, we also cover video, and we study a MixRL stage after MOPD.
blocks.zh:
政策上蒸馏[2,20]现在是小型模型的标准培训后阶段[86].
对于VLMs,单师变体重置可视化嵌入物 [38],引导更新向可视化嵌入物 [95],或从文本老师转移推理 [7].
MOPD将这一设置扩展到几个域名教师[82,45,92].
以后的研究涉及领域[18,63]、教师之间的仲裁[93]或保护一般技能[94]之间的不平衡,一种研究将其与教师产出方面的非政策性SFT[83]相比较。
VLMs的多教师配方 蒸馏图像技能专家 [84],视频和图像专家 [53],RL教师的文本,图像,视频和代理任务 [28].
最近的作品是MMVista Reason [37],该作品在Quen3.5上培训图像推理的普惠制O专家,由MOPD将其分解为一学生,并附有开放数据.
相比之下,我们也覆盖视频,我们研究MOPD之后的MixRL舞台.

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards drives recent gains in LLM reasoning, with group-based methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 59 , 22 ] and the sequence-level GSPO [ 107 ] .
Open VLM recipes apply these methods to image reasoning [ 47 , 66 , 30 , 102 , 58 ] , to video understanding [ 13 , 68 , 32 ] , and to both in one model [ 14 ] .
We use per-domain GSPO only to build the teachers, and we use MixRL both as a baseline and as a new final stage on top of the distilled student.
A few text recipes also continue with RL after MOPD: Nemotron-Cascade 2 runs further domain RL stages [ 92 ] , and iterated MOPD retrains per-domain teachers from the student [ 45 ] .
For single-teacher text OPD, the distilled model is also a stronger start for later RL than the SFT model [ 1 ] .
For omni-modal and GUI students, OPOD and UI-MOPD instead optimize a reward inside the distillation stage [ 106 , 35 ] , and the multi-teacher VLM recipes above end at MOPD.
To our knowledge, our work is the first to study a separate RL stage after multi-teacher distillation in VLMs.
blocks.zh:
以可核查的奖励加强学习,推动了LLM推理方面的近期进展,采用基于群体的方法,如集团相对政策优化[59、22]和序列级普惠制[107]。
开放式VLM配方将这些方法应用于图像推理 [47, 66, 30, 102, 58], 用于视频理解 [13, 68, 32], 并用于一个模型 [14].
我们使用每个域的普惠制O只用来培养教师,我们使用MixRL作为基线和被蒸馏出的学生上的新最后阶段.
少数文本配方在MOPD之后也与RL相接:Nemotron-Cascade 2运行了更多域名RL阶段[92],并重排了MOPD的每个域教师从学生[45].
对于单师文本OPD,蒸馏模型也是后期RL比SFT模型[1]更强大的开始.
对于全方位模式和图形用户界面学生,OPOD和UI-MOPD则优化了蒸馏阶段内部的奖励[106,35],上面的多教师VLM配方在MOPD结尾.
据我们所知,我们的工作是第一个在VLMs的多教师分馏后研究单独的RL阶段.

blocks.en: 3 Recipe
blocks.zh: 3 食谱

blocks.en:
We present our recipe, which consolidates three domain teachers into one vision-language model by Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video.
All models build on Qwen3.5-9B [ 54 ] , and, as shown in Figure 2 , the recipe has three stages: (1) domain teachers, each trained with GSPO, (2) MOPD of the three teachers into one student, and (3) MixRL on top of the MOPD student.
blocks.zh:
我们提出我们的食谱, 将三个域教师整合成一个视觉语言模式,
所有模式都以Quen3.5-9B [54]为基础,如图2所示,食谱分为三个阶段:(1) 域教师,每人接受普惠制O培训;(2) 3名教师的MOPD变为1名学生;(3) MixRL在MOPD学生之上.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en:
Each domain has an SFT set and an RL prompt set, built from public datasets.
We show every source with its size in Figure 3 and provide more details in Appendix A.
Image STEM covers math, science, and visual logic problems, mainly from MMFineReason [ 36 ] , MMVistaReason [ 37 ] , DeepVision-103K [ 62 ] , the STEM part of Vero [ 58 ] , and ViRL39K [ 66 ] .
Image perception covers charts, documents, OCR, counting, grounding, and spatial questions, mainly from FineVision [ 76 ] , ChartVerse [ 41 ] , ChartNet [ 26 ] , and the perception parts of Vero.
Finally, video comes mainly from VideoChat3 [ 33 ] , LLaVA-Video-178K [ 104 ] , OneThinker [ 14 ] , LongVideo-Reason [ 10 ] , Video-HopChain [ 49 ] , CapRL-Video-QA [ 88 ] , and TimeLens [ 100 , 108 ] .

每个域都有由公共数据集所建的SFT集和RL快取集.

blocks.en:
The SFT sets serve the MixSFT baseline and the SFT warm-up of the teachers that we compare (Section 3.3 ).
We replace each response of the SFT sources with a new sample from a model that we give the gold final answer.
This model, the generator, receives the media, the question, and the gold answer, and it writes a thinking trace and a reply that ends in that answer.
After generation, we drop a trace if its final answer differs from the gold answer, if it refers to the given answer, if the generator rejects the gold, or if it is truncated or degenerate.

blocks.en:
For each domain, we consider two generators: Qwen3.5-9B itself, which gives self traces, and the larger and stronger Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ 56 ] .
A stronger generator can write better traces, but work on OPD shows that a stronger teacher is not always a better one, because the gain depends on the compatibility between the student and the teacher [ 1 , 34 , 45 ] .
Self traces, in contrast, stay close to the response distribution of Qwen3.5-9B, so SFT on them changes the reasoning style of the model less before the later stages.
We therefore train one SFT model of each domain on each trace source and compare the two (Table 1 ).
On both image domains, self traces give the better model, with a clear margin on image STEM, whereas on video, self traces give a slightly worse model than the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next traces.
We thus use self traces for image STEM and image perception and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next traces for video.
The final SFT set, M 3 OPD-SFT-1.35M, has 1.35M samples: the 994K image self traces (368K for image STEM and 626K for image perception) and one Qwen3.8-Flash-Next trace for each of the 357K video questions.

更强大的生成器可以写出更好的痕迹,但是关于OPD的研究表明更强大的老师并不总是更好的,因为收益取决于学生和老师之间的相容性[1,34,45].

All stages use the native Qwen3.5 chat template with thinking enabled and no system prompt.

blocks.en:
In the SFT question pool, we remove samples with near-identical media and the same normalized question across all domains.
We then decontaminate all SFT and RL sets against the evaluation benchmarks of Section 4.1 .
We remove a sample if it contains at least half of the word 13-grams of a benchmark question, if one of its images is within a perceptual-hash (pHash) distance of 4 of a benchmark image, or if its video shares a source video identifier or a frame hash with a benchmark video.
Finally, the SFT and RL sets are disjoint on the prompt and media hash.

blocks.en: 3.5 MixRL on top of MOPD
blocks.zh: 3.5 MOPD上方的MixRL

blocks.en:
In the common recipe, the RL prompts serve a single stage, MixRL from the base or SFT model, which has to merge the capabilities of all domains into one policy and to strengthen its reasoning at the same time.
These two roles compete: MixRL can harm individual capabilities [ 37 , 84 ] , and the MixSFT model has mainly learned a reasoning style, so it must learn all domains from a sparse reward at once while it also sharpens its reasoning.
In our recipe, MOPD assumes the first role: distillation merges the capabilities of all three teachers into one policy and already matches or outperforms the MixRL baseline (Section 4.2 ).
The MOPD student is therefore a stronger starting point for RL than the model from which MixRL usually starts.
At the same time, MOPD trains the student to match its teachers, so the teachers bound what the distillation loss can teach, whereas a reward-driven stage does not depend on any teacher and can move the student past this bound.
We therefore use the prompts once more, with MixRL on top of the MOPD student, to examine whether RL from this starting point further improves the model on the same data.
We initialize MixRL from the final MOPD checkpoint and train it on the prompt union M 3 OPD-RL-193K with the GSPO settings and the reward of the teachers, as for the MixRL baseline, which starts from MixSFT instead.
With the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B, the result is our main model, M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B.
blocks.zh:
在共同的食谱中,RL提示服务于单一的阶段,即从基础或SFT模式的MixRL,它必须将所有域的能力合并为一个政策并同时加强其推理.
这两个角色竞争: MixRL可以伤害个人能力[37,84],MixSFT模型主要学习了推理风格,因此它必须同时从微薄的奖励中学习出所有领域,同时它也使推理更加精明.
在我们的食谱中,MOPD承担了第一个角色:分解将所有三位教师的能力合并为一个政策,并且已经匹配或超过了MixRL基线(第4.2节)。
因此,MOPD的学生是RL比MixRL通常从中起步的模式更强大的起点.
同时,MOPD训练学生与其老师相匹配,因此老师将蒸馏损失的能教的内容捆绑起来,而由奖励驱动的舞台并不依赖于任何老师,可以让学生越过这个束缚.
因此,我们再次使用由MixRL在MOPD学生上方的提示,来检查RL是否从这个起点出发,进一步改进同一数据上的模型.
我们从最后的MOPD检查站初始化了MixRL,并在快速结合的M 3 OPD-RL-193K和普惠制O设置以及教师的奖励上对其进行培训,就像MixRL基线一样,该基准是从MixSFT开始的.
随着师资直接从Quen3.5-9B受训,结果是我们的主要模式M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.5-9B [ 54 ] as the base model of every run, and we train SFT with lmms-engine [ 42 ] and GSPO and MOPD with verl [ 61 ] , with vLLM [ 29 ] for the rollout. Appendix D gives all training settings.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on 21 benchmarks in three domains, and for image STEM reasoning, we use DynaMath [ 109 ] , EMMA [ 23 ] , LogicVista [ 81 ] , MathVerse [ 103 ] , MathVista [ 44 ] , MMMU [ 96 ] , MMMU-Pro [ 97 ] and We-Math [ 52 ] .
For image perception reasoning, we use AI2D [ 25 ] , CountBenchQA [ 51 , 6 ] , CV-Bench [ 65 ] , HallusionBench [ 21 ] , MMStar [ 8 ] , OCRBench [ 40 ] , RealWorldQA [ 80 ] and SimpleVQA [ 12 ] .
For video reasoning, we use LongVideoBench [ 77 ] , TempCompass [ 39 ] , Video-Holmes [ 11 ] , Video-MME [ 15 ] and VSI-Bench [ 87 ] .
In addition, all training data is decontaminated against these benchmarks (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们对三个领域的21个基准进行评估,对于图像STEM推理,我们使用DynaMath [109],EMMA [23],LogicVista [81],MathVerse [103],MathVista [44],MMMU [96],MMU-Pro [97]和We-Math [52]。
对于图像感知推理,我们使用AI2D [25], BenchQA伯爵 [51, 6], CV- Bench [65], Hallusion Bench [21], MMStar [8], OCR Bench [40], RealWorldQA [80] 和 SimpleVQA [12].
在视频推理方面,我们使用"长视频"Bench [77],"TempCompass [39]","视频-Holmes [11]","视频-MME [15]"和"VSI-Bench [87]".
此外,所有培训数据都按照这些基准进行消毒(第3.1节)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate all models with one protocol in lmms-eval [ 101 ] , with thinking enabled and a cap of 32768 tokens per response, thinking included.
We sample eight responses per question (temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20) and report the mean accuracy over the eight samples (avg@8).
Images are resized to at most 1,605,632 pixels, and each video frame has at most 65,536 pixels.
Videos shorter than 150 seconds are sampled at 1 fps with at least 4 frames, and from longer videos we sample 150 evenly spaced frames. Appendix C gives the dataset, split and metric of each benchmark and the judge of SimpleVQA.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个协议来评估所有模型 包括每个反应的32768个信使
我们每个问题抽样8个答复(温度为0.6,最高为0.95页,最高为-kk 20),并报告8个样本的平均准确度(avg@8)。
图像被调整为最多1,605,632像素,每个视频帧最多65,536像素.
短于150秒的视频在有至少4个相框的1英尺高空取取取样本,从更长的相框中我们取取取出150个均匀相框. 附 录 C给出了每个基准和SimpleVQA的数据集,分和度量.

blocks.en:
We compare two families of recipes on the same data.
The mixed-training recipes train one model on all domains with no teachers: MixSFT trains Qwen3.5-9B on the union of the three domain SFT sets (Section 3.1 ), the MixRL baseline runs GSPO from the MixSFT checkpoint on the same prompt union as MOPD, with the same GSPO settings as the domain teachers, and we also run the same MixRL directly from Qwen3.5-9B.
The multi-teacher recipes distill one set of domain teachers into one student with MOPD, where the teachers are trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B or after an SFT warm-up.
For each set of teachers, MixRL on top of MOPD uses the same prompts and the same GSPO settings as the MixRL baseline (Section 3.5 ).
The SFT warm-ups and the domain teachers are three models each, one per domain, and we evaluate each of them only on the benchmarks of its own domain, whereas we evaluate all other models on all 21 benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了两个家庭的食谱 在同一数据。
混合培训方法在所有领域培训一个没有教师的模型: MixSFT列车在三个域SFT集(第3.1节)的结合上运行了Quen3.5-9B,MixRL基线运行于与MOPD相同的快速结合上从MixSFT检查站运行的GSPO,其设置与域教师相同,我们还直接运行了从Quen3.5-9B运行的同名MixRL.
多教师配方将一组域名教师与MOPD分解成一名学生,教师直接从Quen3.5-9B或经过SFT热身后接受普惠制O培训.
对于每组教师,MixRL在MOPD上方使用与MixRL基线相同的提示和相同的普惠制O设置(第3.5节).
SFT热身和域教师各有3个模型,每个域一个,我们只根据自身域的基准来评价每个模型,而我们评价所有其他模型的所有21个基准.

blocks.en:
For both sets of teachers, the MOPD student stays close to each teacher on the domain of that teacher and matches the three teachers on average (Table 2 ).
One student therefore keeps the skills of three domain teachers, and it does so for two different sets of teachers.
blocks.zh:
对于这两类教师来说,MOPD学生在教师领域与每位教师保持密切联系,平均与三名教师相匹配(表2)。
因此,一名学生保留了三个域名教师的技能,对两组不同的教师也是如此。

blocks.en:
On the same prompts and with the same start model, MOPD is above mixed training: the MOPD student of the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B is above MixRL from Qwen3.5-9B on average and on most benchmarks (Table 3 ).
It is also above the MixRL baseline from MixSFT on every domain, which is consistent with earlier findings for MOPD on text [ 45 ] and on images [ 37 , 84 ] .
Likewise, the teachers with the SFT warm-up use the same SFT data as the MixRL baseline, so that only the training route differs, and their MOPD student is above the baseline on every domain and on most benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
在同一提示和相同的起步模式上,MOPD高于混合培训:从Quen3.5-9B直接培训的教师的MOPD学生平均高于从Quen3.5-9B和大多数基准上培训的MixRL(表3)。
它也高于MixSFT对每个域的MixRL基线,这与MOPD对文本[45]和图像[37,84]的更早发现一致.
同样,拥有SFT热身的教师使用与MixRL基线相同的SFT数据,因此只有培训路线不同,他们的MOPD学生在每个领域和大多数基准上都高于基线.

blocks.en:
In our setting, the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B are slightly ahead of the teachers with the SFT warm-up on all three domains and on most benchmarks, and MOPD carries most of this difference to its student (Tables 2 and 3 ).
We therefore establish MOPD of the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B as our recipe.
blocks.zh:
在我们的环境下,从Quen3.5-9B直接培训的教师略高于所有三个领域和大多数基准的SFT热身教师,而MOPD将大部分差异带给学生(表2和表3)。
因此,我们把直接从Quen3.5-9B培训的教师的MOPD作为我们的食谱。

blocks.en:
Although MixRL trails MOPD on average as a separate route, the same prompts still carry the student further when MixRL starts from the MOPD student instead of from the base model.
On top of the MOPD student of our recipe, MixRL raises the overall mean and all three domain means, and this model, which has the highest overall mean of all models in Table 2 , is our main model, M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B.
On top of the MOPD student of the teachers with the SFT warm-up, MixRL also raises these means, and this model is above all mixed-training models on every domain.
In both cases, the largest gain is on video, and MixRL on top of MOPD shows no collapse. Per benchmark, MixRL on top of MOPD raises most of the 21 benchmarks for both students, and the few drops are small (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh:
虽然MixRL平均跟踪MOPD作为单独的路线,但当MixRL从MOPD学生开始而不是从基模开始时,同样的提示仍然会让学生更进一步.
在我们食谱的MOPD学生上,MixRL提升了整体的平均值和所有三个域名的含义,这个模型拥有表2中所有模型中最高的整体平均值,是我们的主要模型M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B.
在SFT热身的老师的MOPD学生上,MixRL也提出了这些手段,这个模式首先是每个领域的混合训练模式.
在这两种情况下,最大的收益都在视频上,MixRL在MOPD上方显示没有倒闭. 每个基准,MixRL在MOPD之上提高了两个学生的21个基准中的大部分,而很少的下降(图5).

blocks.en:
Table 4 places our main model next to recent reasoning VLMs on our 21 benchmarks.
M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B has the best or second-best result on almost all of these benchmarks, with best results in all three domains, which shows that the recipe gives one 9B model that is competitive across image STEM, image perception and video.
On average over the benchmarks that each row shares with us, it is above MMVistaReason and its image baselines, above OneThinker and Video-HopChain on both image and video, and above STEP3-VL-10B and MM-OPD on images.
On images, it is also above the larger HopChain-35B-A3B on average, whereas on video, it stays below Video-MOPD, which is built specifically for video understanding.
blocks.zh:
表4将我们的主要模式置于最近的推理之上。
M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B在几乎所有这些基准上都取得了最佳或二佳的结果,在所有三个领域都取得了最佳的结果,这表明食谱给出了一个9B模型,在图像STEM,图像感知和视频上具有竞争力.
平均而言,每行与我们共享的基准都高于MMVistaReason及其图像基线,在图像和视频上高于OneThinker和Video-HopChain,在图像上高于STEP3-VL-10B和MM-OPD。
在图像上,它也平均高于更大的HopChain-35B-A3B,而在视频上,它一直低于Video-MOPD,而Video-MOPD是专门为视频理解而建造的.

blocks.en: In this section, we analyze why MixRL on top of MOPD improves the student, first through the training dynamics of MixRL and then through the change in the reasoning of the model.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们分析MixRL在MOPD上方为什么改善学生,首先通过MixRL的训练动态,再通过模型推理的改变.

blocks.en:
In both mixed-training runs, the training accuracy rises during the run and the response length changes strongly, upward from MixSFT and downward from Qwen3.5-9B.
In contrast, both MOPD students start MixRL with a training accuracy that these runs only approach at the end of the shown steps, and change this length much less (Figure 6 (a) and (c)).
Much of both mixed-training runs thus builds skills that the domain teachers have and that MOPD already transfers to the student.
The group filter drops a prompt when all of its responses are correct or all are wrong, because such a group gives no advantage signal.
From the first step, both students solve more than half of the sampled prompts in all eight responses and start with fewer prompts with no correct response than the mixed-training runs (Figure 6 (b)), so the prompts that remain after the filter give their learning signal at a higher level of ability.
The entropy of the policy also differs (Figure 6 (d)): MixRL from MixSFT starts with a low entropy, whereas the other three runs start with a higher entropy and keep it above this run, and no run shows a sign of entropy collapse.
Since RL mainly sharpens behavior that its start model already shows [ 98 , 17 ] , the start of MixRL decides how far the same prompts can carry the model.
blocks.zh:
在两次混合训练中,训练精度在跑道上上升,反应长度变化很大,从MixSFT向上,从Quen3.5-9B向下.
相比之下,MOPD两个学生在启动MixRL时的训练精度是,这些学生只在所显示步骤的末尾运行,而改变的长度要小得多(图6(a)和(c))。
这两种混合培训中的大部分都培养了域教师拥有的技能,而MOPD已经向学生转让了技能。
组过滤器当其所有响应正确或全部错误时会降出一个提示,因为这样的组不会给出任何优势信号.
从第一步开始,两个学生在所有8个响应中都解决了超过半数被抽样的提示,并以较少的没有正确响应的提示来开始,而不是混合训练跑(图6(b)),因此过滤后留下的提示以更高的能力给出了他们的学习信号.
策略的 en也有所不同(图6 (d):MixSFT的MixRL从低 en起步,而其他三个运行则从更高的 en起步并保持它高于这个运行,没有运行显示有 en倒行的迹象.
由于RL主要磨炼出其起动模型已经表现出来的行为[98,17],MixRL的起动决定了同一提示可以携带该模型多远.

blocks.en:
We study the reasoning of the models at the level of their outputs and treat the thinking part of a response as a sequence of reasoning moves.
We derive the moves from the responses: we collect the most frequent sentence openings in the responses of all models, group them into moves, and check each group by reading samples of the matched sentences.
Similar to the cognitive behaviors of Gandhi et al. [ 17 ] , we count three moves of self-monitoring, namely verifying a result ( e.g . “let’s double-check”, “this matches”), revising a step ( e.g . “wait”, “let me reconsider”), and considering an alternative ( e.g . “or maybe”, “let’s assume”), which we call self-checks.
Since our models express the same move either in the native style of Qwen3.5-9B (“Let’s check”) or in the first-person style of our SFT traces (“Let me check”, “I need to”), each move covers both phrasings, and we normalize the count by the thinking length.
We further describe the allocation of the thinking budget as the ratio of the thinking length on hard questions to that on easy questions, where we rank the questions by the mean solve rate of five models (the domain teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B, their MOPD student, M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B, MixSFT and the MixRL baseline, with easy questions at a solve rate of at least 0.9 and hard questions at most 0.25), the stability as the share of responses with at least five repeated lines, the decisiveness as the share of responses that hedge ( e.g . “probably”, “I’ll go with”), and, on video, the grounding as the number of cited timestamps.
We compute all measures on the logged response of each question, which is the first of the eight samples of the avg@8 evaluation (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们研究模型在输出层面的推理,并将反应的思维部分视为推理动作的序列.
我们从回复中得出这些动作:我们收集所有模型回复中最频繁的句子开口,将它们分组为移动,并通过阅读匹配句子的样本来检查每个组.
与甘地等的认知行为相类似 [17],我们数了自监测的三步,即验证一个结果(例如. “让我们的双重检查”、“这种匹配”、修改一个步骤(例如“等待”、“让我重新考虑”)以及考虑一个我们称之为自我检查的替代方案(例如“或也许”、“假设”)。
因为我们的模特们都用 Quen3.5-9B的本土风格来表达同样的动作 “让我们检查”或用我们的SFT痕迹的第一人称风格(“让我检查”,“我需要”),每个动作都涵盖两种用词,我们按思维长度来计算。
我们进一步将思维预算的分配情况描述为对困难问题的思维长度与对简单问题的思维长度之比,我们用五个模型(直接从Quen3.5-9B、他们的MOPD学生、M 3 OPD-Reasoner-9B、MixSFT和MixRL基线培训的域教师,以至少0.9的解答率和最多0.25个难题的思维长度)的平均解答率对问题进行排序,稳定性作为至少五行重复的答复的比例,决定性作为套期答复的比例(例如 " 可能 " 、 " 我随行 " ),以及在视频上作为引用的时间标数。
我们计算每个问题的记录答复的所有措施,这是avg@8评价的八个样本中的第一个(表5)。

blocks.en:
We discuss four of these measures here, and Appendix F discusses the self-checks, the loops and the other stages (Table 5 ).
The thinking length shows how much budget the model spends, the ratio of this length on hard questions to that on easy questions shows whether it spends the budget where it is needed, the share of responses that hedge shows how firmly it decides, and, on video, the density of cited timestamps shows how much it grounds its reasoning in the clip.
Qwen3.5-9B overthinks, and this holds on video as well, where it thinks at length, many of its responses hedge, and it cites many moments of the clip before it decides.
The MixRL baseline is the opposite case, with short answers on all domains and few cited moments.
The teachers of our recipe set a budget for each domain, long on image STEM and far shorter than that of Qwen3.5-9B on video, and the MOPD student stays close to its teachers in every measure, which shows that MOPD transfers how each teacher reasons and not only what it answers.
blocks.zh:
我们在此讨论其中四项措施,附录F讨论自我检查、循环和其他阶段(表5)。
思维长度显示模型花费了多少预算,在困难问题上花费了多少时间与在简单问题上花费多少时间的比例表明它是否将预算花在了需要的地方,套期的回复份额显示它是如何坚定决定的,在视频上,被引用的时间戳的密度显示它在剪辑中推理的理由有多少.
(笑声) Quen3.5-9B 过度思考,这在视频中也保留着, 它长时间地思考, 其许多反应被套住, 它引用了许多片段的时间 之前它决定。
MixRL基线则相反,在所有领域都有简短的答案,很少引用瞬间.
我们食谱的老师们为每个领域设定了预算,长于图像STEM,远短于视频的Quen3.5-9B,MOPD的学生在每一度量中都保持与老师的亲近,这表明MOPD转移了每个老师的原因,而不仅仅是答案.

blocks.en:
On top of this student, MixRL keeps the thinking length on the two image domains.
On video, in contrast, MixRL replaces the long, timestamped evidence chains of the student with short and direct answers, so the thinking becomes much shorter, hedging responses become rare, and the thinking length depends more on the difficulty of the question.
The density of cited timestamps, however, stays above the level of the student and far above that of the MixRL baseline.
On top of the MOPD student of the teachers with the SFT warm-up, whose thinking length on video hardly depends on the difficulty, MixRL makes it depend clearly on the difficulty, while the responses stay short.
These changes match the gains in Section 4.2 , which are largest on video for both students.
MixRL on top of MOPD thus keeps the skills that MOPD transfers from the teachers and refines them on the domains where the teachers leave room.
blocks.zh:
在这个学生上,MixRL保持两个图像域的思维长度.
在视频上,相形之下,MixRL用短而直接的答案来取代学生的长而有时间戳的证据链,因此思维变得短得多,套期反应变得罕见,思维长度更多地取决于提问的难度.
然而,所引用的时间戳的密度仍然高于学生的水平并远远超过MixRL基线。
在SFT热身的教师的MOPD学生上,他们对于视频的思考长度几乎不取决于难度,而MixRL则使它明显依赖于难度,而反应则保持了短促.
这些变化与第4.2节中的成果相匹配,这两节在视频上对两个学生来说都是最大的.
因此,MixRL在MOPD之上保留了MOPD从教师那里转移的技能,并在教师离开房间的领域加以完善。

blocks.en: Table 6 : MixRL on top of MOPD with and without a prompt filter, for the teachers with the SFT warm-up (domain means and overall mean, avg@8 accuracy, %). h h is the number of solved responses ( R acc ≥ 0.5 R_{\text{acc}}\geq 0.5 ) of the MOPD student among eight samples of a prompt.
blocks.zh: 表6:在MOPD上方使用或不使用即时过滤器的混合RL,用于SFT热身的教师(域名和总体平均值,avg@8精确度,%). hh是MOPD学生的解答数(Rcc 0.5 R_{\text{acc}}\geq 0.5)在8个快取样本中.

blocks.en:
Because MixRL on top of MOPD uses the RL prompts a second time, we also examine whether it needs all of them.
With the MOPD student of the teachers with the SFT warm-up, we sample eight responses for each prompt of the RL training set and let h h be the number of solved responses.
We then compare the full prompt union with two filtered sets, one without the prompts that the student never or always solves ( h ∈ { 0 , 8 } h\in\{0,8\} ) and one with only the prompts that it does not yet solve reliably ( h ≤ 4 h\leq 4 ), where all runs start from the same MOPD checkpoint and use the same settings (Table 6 ).
We find that neither filter improves on the full union.
The run without the prompts with h ∈ { 0 , 8 } h\in\{0,8\} still improves the student and stays close to the full union with far fewer prompts, whereas the run that keeps only the prompts with h ≤ 4 h\leq 4 does not improve the student.
For a fair comparison with the mixed-training MixRL runs, we use the full union for the main results.
blocks.zh:
因为MixRL在MOPD上方第二次使用RL提示,我们也检查它是否需要全部.
随着教师的MOPD学生在SFT热身后, 我们抽取8个响应,
然后我们将完全快速结合与两个被过滤的组合进行比较,一个没有学生从未或总是解决的提示(h {{0,8}h\in\{0,8\}),一个只有它尚未可靠解决的提示(h ≤4 h\leq 4),所有运行都从同一个MOPD检查站开始,并使用相同的设置(表6).
我们发现,无论是过滤器还是过滤器都没有改善整个结合。
使用 h {0, 8} 的无提示的跑步仍然能改善学生,
为了与混合训练的MixRL运行进行公平比较,我们利用完全结合来取得主要结果.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented M 3 OPD-Reasoner, a fully open recipe for reasoning VLMs over image STEM, image perception and video.
On the same curated data, MOPD of GSPO teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B is the best of the compared recipes, and with or without the SFT warm-up, MOPD and MixRL complement each other, as MOPD merges the domain teachers into a stronger starting point for RL than the base model, and MixRL still improves this student on the same data with no collapse.
We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了M 3 OPD-Reasoner, 一个完全开放的配方 推理 VLM 相对于图像 STEM,图像感知和视频。
在同一被整理的数据上,直接从Quen3.5-9B培训的普惠制O教师的MOPD是比较配方中最好的,无论是否SFT取暖,MOPD和MixRL互为补充,因为MOPD将域名教师合并成为比基模更强大的RL起步点,MixRL仍然在同样数据上改善这个学生,没有崩溃.
我们公布所有数据 训练守则 以及每个阶段的检查站

blocks.zh: 附录A 数据

blocks.en: A.1 Sources
blocks.zh: A.1 来源

blocks.en:
Each domain has an SFT set and an RL prompt set built from public datasets (Table 7 ).
For the SFT sets, we keep the questions and gold answers of the sources and replace the original responses with samples from a model that we give the gold final answer.
The SFT question pool contains only single-turn questions with at least one image or video, and multi-turn sources keep their last question.
In contrast, the RL sets keep only prompts with rule-verifiable answers, and Table 8 gives their answer types.
Within one source, a stable hash of the image, video or question splits the items between SFT, RL and a held-out pool, and the SFT part of a source excludes the images of its RL part.
Finally, several RL sources are subsampled, and the pass-rate filters of DeepVision-103K and ViRL39K keep the harder items.

每个域都有由公共数据集所建的SFT集和RL快取集(表7.
对于SFT集,我们保留了来源的问答和黄金答案,并用我们给出黄金最终答案的模型样本来取而代之.
SFT问题池只包含至少一个图像或视频的单回合问题,多回合出处保留了最后一个问题.
相比之下,RL集只保留带有可规则验证的答案的提示,而表8给出了它们的答案类型.
在一个来源内,图像、视频或问题的稳定散列将项目从SFT、RL和一个被搁置的池中分出,而源中的SFT部分排除了其RL部分的图像。
最后,多个RL源被分样取出,而DeepVision-103K和VIRL39K的过分滤波器保留了更难的项目.

blocks.en: A.2 Prompt format
blocks.zh: A.2 提示格式

blocks.en:
All stages and the evaluation use the native Qwen3.5 chat template with thinking enabled and no system prompt.
The user turn holds the media first and then the question, followed by one format instruction for the answer type of the prompt (Table 11 ).
Before we add this instruction, we remove answer-format instructions that the source questions already contain, such as requests for <think> or <answer> tags, an empty box, or “Answer with a single word”.
blocks.zh:
所有阶段和评价都使用原生的Qwen3.5聊天模板,并启用思维,没有系统提示.
用户转动先持有媒体,再持有问题,然后对快取的答题类型(表11)进行格式指示.
在添加此指示之前, 我们删除源问题已经包含的答案格式指令, 例如请求 < think > 或 < sanswer > 标记, 一个空框, 或“ 单词回答” 。

blocks.en: A.3 Deduplication and decontamination
blocks.zh: A.3 分解和去污

blocks.en:
In the SFT question pool, we remove samples with near-identical media and the same normalized question across all domains, and the SFT and RL sets are disjoint on the prompt and media hash.
We then decontaminate every set against the evaluation benchmarks with the rules of Table 9 : exact and 13-gram text overlap, image hashes with a perceptual-hash distance of at most 4, and video identifiers and frame hashes.
The prompt set of MOPD and MixRL is exactly the union of the three teacher RL sets, which forms M 3 OPD-RL-193K.
blocks.zh:
在SFT问题池中,我们用近同种介质取出样本,并在所有域中取出相同的正态问题,SFT和RL集在即时和媒体散列上脱节.
然后,我们按照表9的规则,对照评价基准去除每套污染:准确和13克文本重叠;图像散列,视距为最多4小时;视频识别和帧散列。
MOPD和MixRL的即时集正是三个教师RL集的结合,这三集构成了M 3 OPD-RL-193K.

blocks.en: A.4 Trace source of the SFT data
blocks.zh: A.4 联合国 SFT 数据的追踪来源

blocks.en:
The trace filters (Section 3.1) keep 78.1% of the image self traces and 99.1% of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next video traces.
In addition, MixSFT stays close to the SFT warm-ups on each domain (Table 2 ), so the MixRL baseline and the teachers with the SFT warm-up start from SFT checkpoints of similar quality.
blocks.zh:
微量滤波器(第3.1节)保存了78.1%的图像自有痕迹和99.1%的Qune3.8-Flash-Next视频痕迹.
此外,MixSFT在每个域都保持与SFT热身相近(表2),因此MixRL基线和带有SFT热身的教师从质量相近的SFT检查站起步.

blocks.en:
The trace source also shapes the reasoning style that the later RL keeps (Section F ).
We write the SFT traces with the gold answer given, so they are short and contain few self-checks, and the SFT models take over this profile.
RL from these models adds some self-checks on all domains and makes the responses longer on image STEM, but the responses remain much shorter than those of the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B.
blocks.zh:
微量源还塑造了后期RL所保持的推理风格(F节.
我们用给定的黄金答案来写 SFT 的痕迹,所以它们很短,很少包含自我检查, SFT 模型接管了这个配置.
这些模型的RL增加了所有领域的一些自我检查,使得在图像STEM上的回复时间更长,但回复仍然比从Quen3.5-9B直接培训的教师的回复要短得多.

blocks.en: Appendix B Reward and Answer Matching
blocks.zh: 附录B 奖励和答复匹配

blocks.en: Section 3.2 defines the reward, and this section gives the answer matchers. Before matching, we normalize the prediction and the gold answer by removing math delimiters, bold markers, text macros, quotes, a leading “The answer is” and a trailing period, and by writing percent and degree signs in one form.
blocks.zh: 第3.2节界定了奖励,本节给出了答案匹配者. 在匹配之前,我们通过删除数学分隔符、粗体标记、文字宏、引文、领先的“答案是”和后继时期,以及用一种形式写出百分比和学位标志,实现预测和黄金答案的正常化。

blocks.en:
Table 10 lists the answer types of the RL prompt sets with the rule that scores each type.
The answer matcher depends on the answer type of the prompt (Table 11 ).
For math, we use the Math-Verify library with numeric fallbacks: units must agree when both sides give one, percentages match decimals, multi-part answers match part by part, and a stated relation (“ ≥ 5 \geq 5 ”) never matches a plain value.
For short answers, we match the normalized strings, and a numeric short answer follows the rule for math.
For multiple choice, we accept option letters in common forms and sets of letters for multi-answer questions.
For counting, we accept number words and approximate phrases (“about 7”).
For OCR, we use ANLS with a threshold of 0.5, and different digit sequences score zero.
For grounding, boxes use coordinates in [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] , and the score is the Hungarian-matched IoU sum divided by the larger of the predicted and gold box counts.
A point gold matches when the predicted point is within 20 units or inside the predicted box.
For temporal grounding, we use the matched temporal IoU over the predicted segments.
Finally, before Math-Verify, the prediction is capped at 300 characters (more for long gold answers), and a Math-Verify call times out after 3 seconds.
blocks.zh:
表10列出了RL提示集的解答类型,并附有每类评分的规则.
答案匹配器取决于提示的答案类型(表11).
对于数学,我们使用带有数字倒数的数学校正库:当双方给出一个,百分比相匹配的小数,多个部分的答案相匹配部分,且一个声明的关系(“\\\\\\\\\ 5”)从不匹配一个纯值时,单位必须同意.
对于简短的答案,我们与正态的字符串相匹配,一个数字短的答案遵循了数学的规则.
对于多种选择,我们接受通用形式的选项字母和多答题的一组字母.
就计算而言,我们接受数字词和大致短语(“约7”).
对OCR来说,我们使用阈值为0.5的ANLS,不同的数位序列得分为0.
对于地平面,盒子使用坐标在 [0,1000] [0,1100] 中,分数是匈牙利相配的IoU和除以预测和金盒计数中较大的分数.
当预测点在20个单位内或预测框内时,一个点金相匹配.
就时间定位而言,我们使用相应的时间IoU来覆盖预测的片段。
最后,在Math-Verify之前,预测被封为300个字符(更多的是长取出金子的答案),3秒后一个Math-Verify调用时间被取消.

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价议定书

blocks.en:
We evaluate all models in lmms-eval [ 101 ] (version 0.7.2) with the vLLM backend [ 29 ] and one protocol.
We sample 8 responses per question (temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20) and report the mean accuracy over them (avg@8), with the native Qwen3.5 chat template, thinking enabled and no system prompt.
The response cap is 32768 tokens, thinking included.
Images have between 65,536 and 1,605,632 pixels.
Videos shorter than 150 seconds are sampled at 1 fps with at least 4 frames, and from longer videos we sample 150 evenly spaced frames.
Each frame has 4,096 to 65,536 pixels, the frames are passed to the model as one video, and each frame carries the timestamp text of the Qwen3.5 processor.

我们抽取了每个问题的8个答复(温度为0.6,顶端为0.95页,顶端为-k k 20),并报告上面的平均准确度(avg@8),使用原生的Quen3.5聊天模板,思考启用,没有系统提示。

短于150秒的视频在有至少4个相框的1英尺高空取取取样本,从更长的相框中我们取取取出150个均匀相框.
每个相框有4,096至65,536像素,相框作为一款视频传递给模型,而每个相框带有Quen3.5处理器的时间戳文本.

blocks.en: Appendix D Training Configurations
blocks.zh: 附录D 培训 配置

blocks.en:
Table 13 gives an overview of the settings of all stages, and Tables 14 , 15 and 16 give the full configurations of SFT, GSPO and MOPD.
We train SFT with lmms-engine [ 42 ] (version 0.1.4), and GSPO and MOPD with verl [ 61 ] (version 0.9.1) and vLLM [ 29 ] (version 0.19.1) for rollout, all on PyTorch 2.10.0.
All experiments run on a pool of 64 80GB GPUs, and the released configurations launch every stage on four nodes of eight GPUs, with two training and two rollout nodes for GSPO and two training, one rollout and one teacher node for MOPD.
We train each run until its training metric converges.
All models build on Qwen3.5-9B [ 54 ] , use full-parameter training, and share the media settings of the evaluation protocol.
SFT uses about 1,048,576 tokens per optimizer step in every run, with packed sequences.

Each prompt keeps the domain label of its RL set, and the label routes the full student sequence to the frozen teacher of that domain.
The teachers share the tokenizer and processor of the student, so a teacher scores the student tokens directly, with the same media inputs.
Once a student response ends, a replica of the routed teacher scores the prompt and the response in one prefill pass and returns, for each response position t t , the log-probabilities of its top- k k tokens 𝒦 t \mathcal{K}_{t} ( k = 32 k=32 ).
The teachers never decode, and scoring streams beside generation, so most of the teacher cost overlaps with the student rollout.

blocks.en: Appendix F Reasoning Behavior Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 行为分析

blocks.en: This section uses the measures of Section 5 (Table 5 ), and it analyzes the other stages of the recipe with the same measures.
blocks.zh: 本节采用第5节的措施(表5),并以同样的措施分析食谱的其他阶段。

blocks.en:
In the RL runs of Table 5 , the final model keeps the reasoning style of its start.
The models fall into two groups: Qwen3.5-9B and the models trained from it without SFT reason in the native style of Qwen3.5-9B, and the models trained on our SFT traces reason in the first-person style of these traces.
The phrasing stays the same in each group, since all models in the native style begin their thinking with a restatement of the task (“The user wants”), whereas no model in the first-person style does so, either before or after RL, and in the qualitative check, MixSFT and the MixRL baseline often begin with the same sentences and differ only at single steps (Table 17 ).
RL instead changes the thinking length, the loops, and the way in which the model reaches its decision, which agrees with the finding that RL mainly sharpens behavior that the start model already shows [ 98 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
在Table 5的 RL 运行中,最终型号保留起步的推理风格.
模型分为两组:一是Quen3.5-9B,一是用Quen3.5-9B的本土风格在没有SFT理由的情况下从中训练出模型;二是用这些痕迹的第一人称风格来训练出我们的SFT痕迹理由.
各组的用词不变,因为本土风格中的所有模型都从重述任务开始思考(“用户想要”),而第一人称风格中没有任何模型在RL之前或之后都会这样做,在质检中,MixSFT和MixRL基线往往会以相同的句子开始,只在单步时才有所不同(表17).
RL转而改变思维的长度,循环,以及模型达成决定的方式,这与RL主要能使起始模型已经显示的行为更敏锐的结论一致. [98, 17].

blocks.en: Table 17 : Excerpts from pairs of responses of two models to the same benchmark question. Each row compares the model before and after one stage, and (correct) and (wrong) give the benchmark verdict of the response.
blocks.zh: 表17:两个模型对同一基准问题的对接答复摘录. 每行对一个阶段前后的模型进行比较,(正确)和(错误)给出回应的基准判断.

blocks.en:
Qwen3.5-9B overthinks on all domains [ 9 ] : its thinking on video is also long, part of its responses repeat the same check until the response limit, and on video, it visits many parts of the clip before it decides (Tables 5 and 17 ).
Domain RL keeps this style but sets a different thinking length for each domain, so the image STEM teacher still reasons at length, whereas the video teacher answers with a small fraction of the original length and cites fewer and more relevant moments of the clip.
At the same time, loops become much rarer, and in the qualitative check, the teacher tries another hypothesis and commits to an answer where Qwen3.5-9B checks the same detail again and again.
blocks.zh:
文3.5-9B号 对所有域的过度思考 [9] : 它在视频上的思考也很长,部分答复重复同样的检查直到回复限制,在视频中,它访问片段的许多部分之后再决定(表5和17)。
域名RL保持了这种风格,但为每个域设置了不同的思维长度,因此图像STEM老师仍然在长度上解释原因,而视频老师以原始长度的一小部分回答,并引用了剪辑中更少,更相关的瞬间.
同时,循环变得多为罕见,在质检中,老师尝试了另一种假说,承诺在Quen3.5-9B反复检查相同细节的答案.

blocks.en:
The MOPD student keeps the behavior of each teacher not only on average (Table 5 ) but also per question: of all models, it is the closest to its teachers both in the questions that it solves and in its thinking length on each question ( Table 18 ).
The student of the teachers with the SFT warm-up agrees more with its own teachers than with the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B, so the student follows the specific teachers that it learns from rather than a common behavior of all RL models, and in the qualitative check, it often repeats the plan and even the wording of its teacher (Table 17 ).
This fits on-policy distillation, which trains the student toward the teacher on the student’s own responses [ 2 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
MOPD的学生不仅将每个老师的行为维持在平均水平(表5)上,而且还保持每个问题:在所有模型中,无论是在它所解决的问题中还是在每个问题的思维长度上,它都最接近其老师(表18)。
参加SFT热身的教师的学生与其直接接受Quen3.5-9B培训的教师,不如说是自己自己的教师,因此学生跟随自己学习的具体教师而不是所有RL模型的共同行为,在质检中,学生经常重复计划,甚至重复老师的措辞(表17).
这符合政策上的提炼,

blocks.en:
Besides the changes on video in Section 5, MixRL on top of the MOPD student of the teachers trained directly from Qwen3.5-9B changes little on the two image domains, except that on image perception, the thinking length also depends more on the difficulty of the question.
On top of the MOPD student of the teachers with the SFT warm-up, MixRL also strengthens this dependence on video and adds self-checks, while the responses stay short (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
除了第5节中视频的变化,MixRL在直接从Quen3.5-9B训练的教师的MOPD学生上方,在两个图像域上变化不大,只是在图像感知上,思维长度也更多地取决于问题的难度.
MixRL还强化了对视频的依赖, 并增加了自查内容, 而回复时间却不长(表5)。
